featured_reviews.name: Joseph D'Cruz
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the oldest places in Vakola. This Catholic parish was very large (in terms of members) in the 80's and 90's with almost 30000 families being part of it but due to cost of living going up and real-estate prices going through the roof many have sold their places and moved to the suburbs. Currently the numbers have come down to almost close to 10000 or little above that. Still one of the very active churches in terms of people's participation. There are 5 resident priests allotted to this parish. There's also boys school run by the parish. A very spiritual place and the services are conducted with a lot of vigour and enthusiasm. Truly fulfilling to be part of those.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am truly blessed to be a part of the Rose of Sharon Church from the very begining.

When I came to this church I was totally lost in this world, I had no job and no real happiness in my life. This ministry changed my life completely. Pastor's guidance through God's Word helped me discipline my life in a godly way. She has been a  great support and a prayer warrior in my life and my difficult days.

Today I have a life that is immensely blessed by God.  A good job, a happy family life, a beautiful home and a good husband who has also found spiritual guidance and  blessings thorough our ministry.

We are both blessed only because of Jesus' love that we found through our ministry, and because of the love,  support and guidance  of our dear Pastor, who is also a spiritual mother to all of us.

I am so thankful to God for the blessing of our holy church and of our dear Pastor in my life.

featured_reviews.name: Obed Roberts
featured_reviews.review_text:
Praise The Lord, The Lord  truly resides in this place, and has done wonderful and great marvelous work here in this Rose of Sharon Church to which I am a witness. (ANGEL and SAVITHA) who were members of this church in the past and my family members aswell have done great mistake against this holy temple and the Lord who resides in this place. During Lockdown 2020 they Left me, my sister and my Father at the utmost bad state due to conflict within our own family. But God took care of us till today and has been very gracious and merciful towards me, my elder sister and my dad . Through Pastor's prayer and her councelling we have not only survived these many years but have been blessed through her and the Lord who resides in this Rose of Sharon Church. Today these 2 (ANGEL and SAVITHA) are bearing false witness against our church and have mentioned evil things in various places which is to the utmost lies and false. They have left our family, they stayed with strangers on their own without our knowledge, my mother (SAVITHA) never took care of the family, my sister (ANGEL) never wanted to stay or be with us. In the past through our Pastor's prayer and our Lord grace, They received so many miracles and blessings in their life, but still today they are so ungreatful and Liars.
I would like to share few testimonies how God has worked in my life through this Church and through our Dear Pastors prayers and councelling.

1) My birth itself is a testimony, before I was born I had 2 sisters and my parents were planning to do family planning, but our Lord revealed to our pastor that I will be born to which our pastor informed my parents. Many people and relatives in our family never believed that a boy will be born after 2 daughters and we're waiting to see how it turns out. But as per our Lord's promise I was born and it shocked everyone within my family.

2) from my childhood itself for many years I had very bad asthamatic kind of Cough and it used to worsen while sleeping. I couldn't sleep well and used to have bad chest pains and throat aches due to continuous coughing. My parents took me to various doctors, did various tests and took various medicines. But it was of no use . For many years we kept trying by our might and strength to resolve this but nothing happened. Finally we informed our pastor about this , she prayed over me in church and at that very moment till today I do not have such kind of cough ever.

3) I was interested in doing hotel management after completing my 12th, tried various management programmes but failed. But instead of bringing it to our God's guidance and Pastor's prayer my family and I did my admission in hotel management University where I studied there for 3 years, immediately during my last year before graduation, lockdown came in due to coronavirus. Due to which the industry that I was studying in was severely hit. My pastor was very concerned for me and prayed for me everyday to which I smoothly completed by graduation and landed a job at a reputed company. But as I mentioned earlier it wasn't God's will and my family and I never asked for god's guidance and moved ahead because of that I suffered very much in that company due to long working hours and my life had become completely miserable. On informing this to our pastor she confidently told me to leave the job and search for somewhere else and keep faith in God he will do mighty works. I didn't believe at first and it was hard as I was jobless for 6-8 months. But by god's Grace I got a good job till today in a complete different field with a salary which I wouldn't be able to get in hotel industry due to years of hardwork.

I would like to thank my Lord Jesus Christ and my Dear Pastor for her love and guidance.

Our Lord through our church has always given us and everyone who seeks him with true heart blessings and has been compassionate and Caring and I testify to this.
Those reading this Comment I urge you to not turn your life as these 2 who are ungreatful and hypocrites for their own caused misery. Praise The Lord, Thankyou Jesus!

featured_reviews.name: Shalaka Salins
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been part of this church since childhood, and today as an adult, I can confidently say I have grown here—spiritually and personally. The people I’ve seen remain and thrive are those who truly seek God diligently through His Word.

This church has been a place of transformation in my life. I received salvation here, and my faith has deepened over the years. I also experienced healing from fibroids that I suffered from for years—something I truly believe is a blessing from God through faith and prayer.

From my day-to-day life to my education and life decisions, God has been with me through it all. Every guidance, every prayer I have received in this church, and the direction given through Pastor has played a significant role in making me stronger and victorious in my life.

The teachings here are rooted in the Word of God—nothing watered down to please ears, but truth that sometimes corrects and challenges. The Bible says, “Seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things shall be added unto you,” and I have experienced this promise in my life.

Here, I was taught to read, meditate on, and follow the scriptures for myself. God is love, yes—but His Word is also a two-edged sword that refines and transforms us.

If you are someone who truly seeks God—not just comfort, but truth, growth, and a deeper walk in His light—this church is a place where you can experience that.

This is my testimony, and I continue to feel blessed beyond measure.

featured_reviews.name: Ramiah Daniels
featured_reviews.review_text:
My heart is filled with deep joy as I testify and rejoice at the great works of the Lord in my life through the Rose of Sharon Church, Kalina, Mumbai.
I have been a member of this blessed church since 1999, and my family and I have benefitted from the Word of God expounded by our Pastor Saroja M over the years. She is a mother to all members, even as a hen watches over her brood, praying constantly for our well-being and health and safety. Her counsel, when sought, is priceless, and it is only when one realises that this counsel is not of this world, but from the Spirit of the Lord, that one benefits from her advice and counsel.
A loving, caring, and disciplined Pastor, she will always teach us only as per the Holy Bible. When we receive her correction, it is a blessing, for it helps straighten our paths and keep us on our road to salvation.
Over the last 27 years, we have witnessed many personal miracles, blessings, and mighty deeds of our Lord Jesus in our lives and we owe a lot of this to our Pastor’s teaching, counsel, correction, and fellowship at the Rose of Sharon.

Specific miracles we have received from the Lord God through Pastor Saroja’s prayer over the years are many, but here are a couple
1)	In 2015, my dad’s LVEF Echo (Heart) parameters were at 20%. An LVEF of 20% indicates severe heart failure, specifically reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). It means the left ventricle pumps out only 20% of the blood filling it with each beat—far below the normal 50% - 70% range, signifying the heart cannot effectively supply enough oxygenated blood to the body. A Heart Surgeon I consulted told me to expect the worst and that any time, my dad could suffer a fatal attack. I tearfully called Pastor and she prayed for my dad. By the grace of God, dad is doing fine even today at 93, and in relatively good health, able to visit his church in Pune regularly! In fact, when we took the Dopple 2D Echo Test in 2020, his LVEF Echo (Heart) parameters showed 64%. Now, is that a miracle or what???
2)	In 2022, my mom had a brain stroke and was lying paralysed for over an hour at home. Finally, when help arrived and she was taken to hospital, I got to know and immediately called Pastor Saroja to ask for her prayers. Mom has recovered since and is able to even do work in the house and lead a relatively normal life, going to church regularly, even now at 91. Another miracle, showing us Lord Jesus’ mercy!

I thank Pastor from the bottom of my heart for all her support and prayers and for her constant encouragement in the Lord. May God bless her abundantly for all that she does for us, her flock!
Thank you Jesus!

Ramiah Daniels
Bangalore

featured_reviews.name: Lavina lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
After being a member for 20 plus years in this wonderful Rose of Sharon Church, I can't imagine how my life would have been without our Good God and His Beloved Son Jesus Christ because in every phase of my life there were miracles and blessings by being in this living Church of God and my dear Pastor (Saroja) prayers. When I newly came into this Church I was about 23 years old and was not from a well to do family for my marriage, but through our good Lord Jesus and dear Pastor’s prayers in my 24th year on 7 January 2002 I got married without any problem or demands.

Then in February 2003 God blessed me with a son as I had a C-section because of my mistake as I had lots of meat at that time and got overweight, so my son when he was a year child got heat boil on his head but my dear Pastor's advice and prayers he got completely healed. Later on as he grew about 2 or 3 years old, he got piles, a small piece of flesh used to come out whenever he passed stool. But without consulting my Pastor I took him to doctor where I was given a long list of what he should not eat, that was almost nothing he can have and then l informed my Pastor regarding the same and she advised me to apply prayer oil and assured of her faithful prayers and within the period of 4 months  time he got completely healed as he is now 23 years old fit and healthy by God's Grace.

Now in the crucial year of 2004 I was pregnant for 2nd child where my husband didn't had job and as our Pastor had asked my sick father in law to stay in Rose of Sharon Ashram  in Mangalore who was suffering from lung cancer had come to Mumbai for his treatment and to live with us, and in mid of all chaos and fights in family my Pastor continually comforted me and my husband and assured us for her continuous pray for me to have a normal delivery, and as I got admitted to hospital for delivery the doctor told me that the child has not come down that's why she will have to go for C-section and assured me it is almost impossible to get second time normal because first time I had C-section and called for C-section doctor to come over for the operation, yet as my husband continually talking to my Pastor and she assured us for her faithful prayers, as I was going to the operation room for the last time the doctor wanted to check the baby and for her surprise the baby had come down and by God's Grace I had a normal delivery.

After my  2nd child on 2005 our life changed as per the Lord’s word spoken by our Pastor and her heartily prayers in that year my husband got job and we were blessed with our own house on October 2005 which our Pastor looked for us and not only that but also personally helped us to purchase biggest things to the smallest things which were needed for the new house.

After living happily with my family for 15 years in our new home, I was suddenly diagnosed with hereditary diabetes due to some carelessness, and my sugar level rose dangerously to 533. This led to a severe infection (pus) on the left side of my neck, requiring immediate surgery to prevent paralysis. During this critical time, I experienced God’s love through our Pastor, who constantly checked on my condition, stayed in touch with my family and doctors, and prayed for me sincerely. By God’s grace and her prayers, I was healed and given a new life.

A few years later, during COVID-19, I again faced a difficult time when I became the first woman in my area to test positive and was hospitalized along with my two children on separate floors, while my husband was abroad. It was an extremely painful and lonely experience, worsened by insensitive neighbors. Yet, through it all, I continued to witness God’s love and the unwavering faith, care, and guidance of His spiritual servant.

Through these trials, my faith has grown stronger. Like a plant nurtured over time, I have been spiritually guided, corrected, and blessed abundantly. I can never repay God, but I offer my heartfelt gratitude and praise to Him.
Praise the Lord.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Malvankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I studied at OLPS High School, and my experience there was largely challenging.
While the school maintains discipline and places importance on English communication, I felt that this focus was not always inclusive. There appeared to be an indirect pressure to adopt a certain style of English conversation, which at times made students like me feel uncomfortable rather than supported.
As a student who was not academically strong at the time, I expected guidance and encouragement. Instead, I was denied access to the school library due to my below-average grades—despite the fact that my family was paying the required fees. This felt discouraging, as such resources should ideally help students improve, not restrict them.
Coming from a middle-class background, adjusting in the school environment was not easy, and it affected my confidence. I also felt that there were differences in how students from different backgrounds were treated.
In my observation, many middle-class families enroll their children in such institutions with high hopes, but sometimes feel that their children are gradually influenced towards a particular cultural or religious environment, which may not always align with their own roots. Over time, this difference becomes more noticeable.
I also noticed changes in inclusivity—for example, earlier celebrations like Christmas involved all students, but later it appeared that certain benefits, like gift distribution, became more limited in participation.
Despite these challenges, I have moved forward through my own hard work and dedication. Today, I am an Advocate and have completed my post-graduation in law.
I believe educational institutions should focus not only on discipline and communication, but also on equal opportunity, inclusivity, and encouraging every student regardless of their academic performance or background.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Perpetual Succour High School, located in Chembur, Mumbai, is an esteemed educational institution that combines academic excellence with a strong spiritual foundation. Having had the privilege of being associated with this school, I am delighted to share my thoughts on both the church and the school.

The church of Our Lady of Perpetual Succour, situated on the school premises, is a magnificent structure that exudes tranquility and serenity. It serves as a place of worship and provides a spiritual haven for students, staff, and the local community. The church's architecture is awe-inspiring, with its elegant design and stained-glass windows depicting biblical scenes. The peaceful ambiance and soul-stirring hymns create a serene atmosphere for prayer and reflection.

As for the school, Our Lady of Perpetual Succour High School is renowned for its commitment to academic excellence and holistic development. The faculty members are highly qualified and dedicated, nurturing students' intellectual curiosity and fostering a love for learning. The school offers a well-rounded curriculum that encompasses academics, sports, arts, and co-curricular activities, ensuring the holistic development of students.

The infrastructure of the school is impressive, with spacious classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, a library stocked with a vast collection of books, and state-of-the-art sports facilities. These resources provide students with a conducive environment for learning and exploring their interests.

What sets Our Lady of Perpetual Succour High School apart is its emphasis on character formation and moral values. The school's mission is to instill in students a strong sense of ethics, compassion, and social responsibility. Through various initiatives, such as community service projects and value-based education, the school nurtures students to become responsible citizens and compassionate individuals.

The co-curricular activities offered by the school are diverse and engaging, providing students with opportunities to showcase their talents and develop essential life skills. From debates and elocution competitions to sports tournaments and cultural events, the school encourages students to explore their passions and excel in various fields.

Furthermore, the school fosters a warm and inclusive environment where students feel supported and valued. The sense of camaraderie among students and the strong bond between teachers and students create a nurturing ecosystem that enhances the overall learning experience.

In conclusion, Our Lady of Perpetual Succour High School, along with its beautiful church, is an exceptional institution that combines academic excellence with a strong spiritual foundation. The school's commitment to holistic development, character formation, and inclusivity sets it apart. It is truly a place where students not only receive quality education but also grow into compassionate individuals with a strong sense of purpose.
